one_liner: The card opens as soon as the user taps to start a new chat, before they pick who to talk to.
author: aadi

change.what_is_different_here: The Luzia+ paywall (s02) lists 'Advanced reasoning mode' (s02.e03) as a paid feature. A returning free user sees a one-day, 3-answer sample of it on the Chats home (s01) the moment they tap New chat, under the existing Luzia+ badge (s01.e02). The full feature stays behind the Weekly / Monthly / Annual plans and the 3-day trial (s02.e19).
change.trigger_event: On the first open after 3 or more days away, a user without Luzia+ taps to start a new chat; the card opens right away, before they pick who to talk to
change.placement: A card that opens over Chats as soon as the user taps New chat, before the list of who to talk to.
change.frequency_cap: 1 per day, resets at midnight local time; shown only on the first New chat tap after a 3+ day gap
change.decline_path: Tapping 'Not now' closes the card, and the user picks who to talk to as usual. The card does not return until the user's next gap of 3+ days.

flow_steps.caption: A user who hasn't opened Luzia in 3+ days taps New chat to start talking.
Before they can pick who to talk to, a welcome-back card opens and offers 3 answers in Advanced reasoning mode for a short game.
The user plays a short sponsored game and can close it at any time.
The card changes to '3 Advanced reasoning answers ready today. Start a chat.'
